title.narrative: Support for the Management of Public Infrastructure Projects in Paraguay

description.narrative: The general objective of the project is to support the Directorate of Strategic Projects (DIPE) of the Ministry of Public Works and Communications (MOPC) of Paraguay in the management of contracts for infrastructure and road construction and design of works. Road networks are of the utmost importance for the socio-economic development of the country and have a direct impact on the increasing access to livelihoods and markets.\n
